The one that is not a broker · 1,450 stars · MIT

mnemox-ai/tradememory-protocol

Local-first memory and a risk brake for AI trading agents. It learns from your own losing history and can refuse orders that break your rules before they reach the broker. Nothing in the stack does this.

8 more are already covered, mostly Tradier, which traderdaddy-bridge already normalizes into. Stars are not quality: several of the best gaps here have 0 to 4.
